text:
Rachel: Quick proposal - instead of ad-hoc followups can we try a weekly remediation board + short owner commits? Thinking this will stop actions from falling through the cracks.
Dmitri: yes please. the current tracker is too noisy. weekly focused sync sounds good. :+1:
Maya: love this. can we require an explicit 'escalation window' for P0/P1 actions (e.g., 48h for triage + 2w for fix)?
Rachel: exactly - propose: Triage owner assigned within 48h, remediation owner and due date within 5 business days, rolling 2-week fix window for engineering remediations.
Sam: who runs the weekly board? IC rotation or a rotating 'postmortem lead'?
Rachel: rotation idea - whoever was IC for the incident facilitates the first remediation proposal, then board assigns owners. We keep facilitation separate from commitments.
Alex: can we have a lightweight template to capture root cause, action, owner, due, and risk if delayed? saves a ton of followup back-and-forth.
Rachel: yep - simple CSV/markdown row that we attach to the postmortem. Example: 
```
Incident, Root cause, Action, Owner, Due, Risk if delayed
INC-2024-123, cache invalidation bug, add stronger validation + test, @Maya, 2024-05-10, potential repeat under high load
```
Dmitri: also add a 'recurrence flag' - if anything hits the same subsystem twice in 90 days, it gets automatic priority and mandatory canary tests.
Maya: smart - we should include a short signal/metrics snippet to detect recurrence: e.g., increase in lat_p99 > 2x or error-rate > 0.3% over baseline.
Sam: operationally, can we make the board a single Google Sheet / Notion page with status + slack alert for overdue items? minimizes context switching.
Rachel: yep - prefer single source of truth. I'll spin up a Notion template and export CSV. Anyone want to co-edit the template?
Alex: I can draft the template this afternoon. I'll include columns: owner, status (todo/in-progress/blocked/done), due, incident link, notes, recurrence-flag, last-updated.
Dmitri: proposal for cadence: 30m weekly remediation sync; each item capped 5m; board owner triages before sync and escalates any blocked items to the SRE lead.
Maya: +1. Also add a monthly rollup for recurring patterns - ops team to present patterns and candidate systemic fixes.
Rachel: agreed. action items: 1) Alex to produce template (due 24h), 2) Rachel to create Notion + invite eng-oncall group (48h), 3) Dmitri to write recurrence rule and alerts (1 week). I'll post this as a short runbook once fleshed out.
oncall-bot: Reminder - weekly remediation sync added to #eng-oncall calendar for Fridays 10:00 starting next week. :calendar: 
Sam: thanks - small ask: include timezones in the invite (we have APAC folks).
Rachel: will do. thanks everyone - if no objections I'll share the first draft template in this thread by EOD. 
Maya: no objections from me. :white_check_mark:
Dmitri: looks good. this should reduce churn on postmortems.
Rachel: closing this thread for now, will reopen with the template link.
